units.source_text: 名人从圣路加医院出院后，已经三个月没有下围棋了，现在又在伊东的暖香园继续对弈。

en.t: After the Master was discharged from St. Luke's Hospital, he had gone three months without playing go, and now he resumed the match at Dankoen in Ito.

units.source_text: 第一天，从黑101到105，仅下五手，就发生了纠纷，下次哪天续弈也定不下来。

en.t: On the first day, after only five moves, from Black 101 to 105, a dispute arose, and they could not even decide when the next session would be held.

units.source_text: 名人病倒，大竹七段又不同意改变对局条件，坚持要放弃这盘棋。

en.t: The Master had fallen ill, and Otake, seventh dan, would not agree to changing the conditions of the match, insisting instead on forfeiting the game.

units.source_text: 这场纠纷，比箱根那次还难以解决。

en.t: This dispute was even harder to resolve than the one at Hakone.
